native_model: Bayesian reinforcement-learning account that maintains uncertainty over reward parameters and latent reward-coupling structure
modeled_internal_state: posterior probability over independent versus coupled reward-generation structure
memory_representation_state: belief sufficient statistics/posterior encode accumulated evidence; raw trial history remains external input history
prediction_state: posterior predictive reward/value consequences conditional on structure belief
learned_parameters: updated reward and structure beliefs; distinct from fixed experimenter candidate-model definitions
action_skill_variables: chosen option/action under belief-state value; not a motor-skill representation
update_transition_rules: Bayesian update of reward parameters and structure probability from observed rewards
retrieval_readout_rules: belief state is read to compute action values
prediction_generation_operators: posterior predictive reward/value calculation under structure uncertainty
learning_plasticity_rules: Bayesian evidence update; Q-learning is a comparator, not central update rule
negative_adverse_results: Independent/coupled reward-generation alternatives are experimenter-defined candidate structures, not evidence of a universal internal generative model.
The model explicitly ignores dependencies across trials and the source says reward-structure learning ultimately must integrate temporal-dependency learning.
A nontrivial subset of choices is not captured by the compared models; fit does not establish neural implementation.
Q-learning with softmax is a comparator and must not be merged into the central model.
anti_conflation_assertions: raw reward history is not identical to internal posterior state
experimenter-defined hypothesis space is distinct from subject/model belief over that space
posterior prediction is not a persistent coordinator separate from belief state
Q-learning comparator is not part of the target architecture
